metric_policy.credited_position: a result holding a relevant item that no earlier result held
metric_policy.precision: credited positions in the top K / K; missing results count as misses
metric_policy.ndcg: gain 2^grade - 1 of the highest-graded item a credited position newly finds, discount log2(rank + 1), ideal from the labeled relevant items ranked by grade, one per position
metric_policy.fingerprint: P0 metrics and summary only; P1 metrics are derived from the fingerprinted ranks

paired_difference.unit: evaluated answerable questions present in both configurations
paired_difference.benefit_rule: P10-6: ndcg@5 interval lower bound > 0 and the candidate's nearest-rank p95 search latency <= 5.0 s; judged on the full benchmark only

notes: Indicative only: 36 answerable and 14 unanswerable questions; one question moves a mean by 0.028.
FR-18 thresholds are calibrated on `benchmark_smoke` only (P10-8): 30 of these 50 questions are in it and 20 are held out. Refusal proposals computed on this run are descriptive and not for adoption.
Results are cut at rank 5: MRR scores 0 when the first relevant item is below that rank.
Precision@K credits at most one position per labeled relevant item, so a question with n labeled items scores at most n / K.
1 searchable document(s) outside the evaluation manifest were excluded from every search.
